title: Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian dish made with marinated chicken cooked in a flavorful tagine sauce. This recipe is a perfect blend of spices and herbs that will transport your taste buds to the markets of Algiers.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Algerian spice blend, peppery, and zingy. Cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the tagine and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
